mass_method: CAD tessellated volume/centroid/inertia normalized to each inventory mass; purchased envelopes assumed uniform density.
collision_method: Primitive proxies, four rigid foot pads, mouth roof/toe/walls; visual meshes have contacts disabled.
servo_dynamics: Position PD, continuous rated force cap, speed/target slew and bus-delay emulation in the environment/controller.
grasp_fixture: Robot base is fixed only in jammyfox_grasp.xml; object remains a free rigid body, with frictional contacts and no weld/adhesion.
